structural_change: S81U-CAP2: the flat s81sl_cap failed the clock rule (22,261 sinks / one root, TT insertion 368.5 ps > 300, physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap/gate_result.json); split into 2 x tree leaf (s81sl_cap_tr, one master, E instance MY) + root leaf (s81sl_cap_rt) with own clock roots and registered seams (nc RST flop -> n6 P1 flop, no added edge), parent s81sl_capc = instances + wiring. S81U-CAP3: pairing-store lookups read one register early with forwarding (gate's 18-level fb_t -> cnt stage, ~795 ps), reset relay 20 copies, SRAM on the lattice; 0 edges moved (cap_bench identical). S81U-CAP5 (CAP3 gate WARN: n6_t[13] / re_t[13] 3,604 loads, TT ins 328.1 / spread 104.6, resets 401 / 384, u_add s2_small -> s3_val ~647 ps): look-ahead slot / h selects replicated per slot group as kept registered copies (n6 output stage moved into the leaf, u_n6 RST 0), store key / es moved into the slot groups (group-local 8:1 then across-group 8:1), both adders ot_s81_fadd_pipe (bit-identical, valid-only reset, single add in stage 3), clk pin to the N-face centre (128-131) over the macro / store mass; 0 edges moved (cap_bench SLCAP lines identical). HOURLY-S81/CAPRT 2026-10-19: the CAP5 adder change no longer touches the SHARED ot_s81_retn_static.sv (closed s81sl_cap_tr / s81net_node views stay source-identical): u_n6 is ot_s81sl_cap_rt_retn = ot_s81_retn_static verbatim with u_add = ot_s81_fadd_pipe, both defined in ot_s81sl_cap_rt.sv; same netlist function, 0 edges. RESET-LANDING (ROOT-RST d4c49c8d3): rst_n reached 22 sinks (2 sync + 20 relay clears of ot_rst_relay) > 2 -> kit reset_landing 2 stages (rst_n -> rst_n__ot_rl0 -> rst_n__ot_rl1 -> u_rr): reset assert/release +2 cycles (scheduled constant), data latency unchanged. io_hold_margin_ns 0.0 -> 0.025 (KITS 10-18 rule).

job.purpose: S81U-CAP2: capture-root ROOT leaf (n6 + direct-mapped finish store SRAM + leaf decode), 1 instance in s81sl_capc; benched through the composed ot_s81sl_cap.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every data input lands in a flop at the pin (the *_c capture flops) and every output is a flop; recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

why_floorplan: 259.2 x 108 (S81U-CAP3): SRAM at (43.2, 43.2) on the 43.2 lattice (CAP2 had it off-lattice at 23.04 / 23.76); its rd_out pins sit on its W edge and wd_in on its E edge, so the outline is 6 lattice steps wide to leave a ~42-um std-cell column on each side; one contiguous ring band (S 41 um: DEC + cw outputs to the S face; N 33 um: n6 / FIN under the N pins; W/E 41-42 um: pairing store, beside the macro's ports). clk/rst_n mid N face between the trees (cluster spine channel); N face = W-tree word (under u_tw), cfg + cw_n (middle), E-tree word (under u_te MY); S face cw_s + fault; ~10k flops, one root. S81U-CAP5: clk moved to the N-face centre 128-131 um (was 106-110), rst_n / cw_n_v / cw_n_a shifted W of it. S81U-CAP5 gate 2 (a83851436): TT 326.9 / spread 104.3 with the latest sinks = u_n6 adder / port flops in the top-right density hotspot of the 27.5-um N band (78.3..105.8 above the macro): outline 108 -> 116.64 so the N band is ~36 um like the S band (macro stays at (43.2, 43.2) on the lattice; util ~46%).
